attachments.origin_landmark: inner surface of the ischiopubic ramus
attachments.insertion_landmark: perineal body and the median raphe

innervation.root_levels: S2-S4 (deep perineal branch of the pudendal nerve)

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Lies in the deep perineal pouch alongside the external urethral sphincter, with which it is continuous. Damage here contributes to post-prostatectomy stress incontinence.
